title: AHHHH RACHEL!!!!! #evita #jamielloyd #rachelzegler #evaperon #andrewl...
transcript: I'm literally in Finland but the news waits for no one Rachel Zegler is making her West End debut in Evita at the London Palladium this summer less than a year after making her Broadway debut in Romeo and Juliet we're gonna get to see her in a musical finally don't get me wrong I loved Romeo and Juliet but a musical now now it's funny because she was actually rumored for another evita revival but this is the Jamie Lloyd production that's going to be this summer from June 14th to September 6th this is the production that Jamie Lloyd did at the Regent's Park Open Air Theatre a few years ago but obviously London Pladium is a much different venue so I'm so curious how it's going to translate apparently it is very Jamie Lloyd and very very dance heavy so I'm super curious how that is all going to come together especially with Rachel now we don't have any other casting it but apparently Jamie Lloyd is in New York meeting with other actors for key roles it's also really special because we know how much Rachel Zegler loves evita she's talked about loving the show so much like Eva Perón is obviously a real person a historical icon but then also like a iconic musical theater character so I'm very very excited to see her do it and to hear her sing but yeah looking at the dates and knowing Jamie Lloyd my guess is that this will be coming to Broadway again nothing is confirmed but if I had to guess I would guess spring of 2026 or fall of 2026 we will see this production of evita on Broadway and that'll obviously have a lot of Tony implications which I am here for and I've actually never seen Evita so for Rachel to be my first Eva it feels like perfect
classificationReason: Casting news reaction: Rachel Zegler joining Jamie Lloyd's Evita at the London Palladium. Creator is in Finland reacting to the announcement with no first-hand attendance. Evita is not in the provided show list, so showId is null.
